infectionStatus.en: Medical tests confirm the presence of Oripathy infection.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

value.en: Medical tests confirm the presence of Oripathy infection.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: Talulah, founder and former leader of the Infected resistance organization "Reunion." She once led Reunion in multiple battles against the official forces of the Ursus Empire who persecuted the Infected. Through years of development and accumulation, Reunion absorbed a vast number of Infected and ordinary civilians, ultimately becoming a pivotal force in the Saint Petersburg Revolution. Following the revolution, Talulah voluntarily dissociated herself from Reunion. Now receiving Oripathy treatment at Rhodes Island under the recommendation of Operator Ch'en.
text.zh: 塔露拉，感染者反抗组织“整合运动”的创始者暨前领导人。曾带领整合运动多次与迫害感染者的乌萨斯帝国官方势力展开战斗。经历多年的发展与积累，整合运动吸纳了数量众多的感染者和普通民众，最终成为圣骏堡革命中的一支关键力量。革命结束后，塔露拉主动脱离了整合运动。现在干员陈的推荐下于罗德岛接受矿石病治疗。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the operator's internal organs are indistinct in outline with abnormal shadows visible. Originium granule abnormalities detected in circulatory system, indicative of Oripathy infection. Confirmed infected with Oripathy at this stage.

[Cell-Originium Fusion Rate] 17%
The patient's previous lesion on her right arm has metastasized, with distinct crystallization visible under her right ribs.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.46 u/L
The patient frequently encounters Originium in harsh battlefield environments year-round; her condition is cause for concern.

To supplement, aside from Oripathy, we detected over a dozen old wounds of various sizes left on the patient from the battlefield. Even with the Draco's physical fitness significantly surpassing ordinary Terran races, the impact of these traumas on the patient's body has reached a level that cannot be ignored.
As a medical order alone, it is strongly recommended that the patient recuperate in a suitable environment.
—Medical Operator

Thank you. Regardless, having a clearer understanding of one's physical condition is always a good thing.
—Talulah
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】17%
患者原本位于右臂的病灶已经发生转移，右侧肋下可见明显结晶。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.46u/L
患者常年在恶劣的战场环境中频繁接触源石，病情不容乐观。

需要补充的是，在矿石病之外，我们在患者身上检测到了大小十余处在战场上留下的旧伤，即使德拉克有着明显强于一般泰拉种族的身体素质，这些创伤对患者身体造成的影响也到了不容忽视的程度。
仅作为医嘱，强烈建议患者在适宜的环境中静养。
——医疗干员

谢谢你们。无论如何，对自己的身体状况有一个更清晰的认知总是好事。
——塔露拉

text.en:
[Privilege Record]
A drastic change has occurred in Ursus, even faster than we anticipated.
We have witnessed the end of an empire, and also bore witness to the establishment of the first conventional state on this land governed with the participation of the Infected.
Naturally, this news is indeed heartening, and such resistance can be called great. Yet amidst the joy, we must also remain mindful of potential impending changes.
The revolution in Ursus will serve as a strong signal for the entirety of Terra. In other countries, the plight of the Infected may welcome change, but even good changes are always accompanied by growing pains. We ought to pay closer attention to regional reactions to this matter, and Rhodes Island intends to do our utmost to prevent tragedies from occurring in the turmoil that may follow.
Fortunately, the new Ursus government has shown a positive attitude toward communication with other countries. Kazimierz and Victoria are also willing to jointly establish a communication mechanism. If we can resolve the crisis of the depletion of the Kolossha main mineral vein in this manner, we also have confidence in proving, amidst any difficulties, that contemporary Terran civilization possesses the value to endure.
Now, the current agenda is how we should handle our relationship with the organization that has inherited the name "Reunion."
...
I think we can reach a consensus.
Those pains are real; they will not fade with time, and this holds true for any Operator who experienced those events. We will not speak of "forgiveness" unconditionally.
Yet when we look back at the events of Chernobog and Lungmen five years ago, even with all manner of sordidness and conspiracy tangled within them, those struggles were the genesis of today's revolution.
We cannot simply use "enemy" to describe Reunion, and we will not forget those fighters and their convictions. This path is not entirely flawless, and amidst it all, the evil that Rhodes Island is dedicated to combating remains ever-present.
As for Talulah—
Rhodes Island will retain the right to continue monitoring her, but this will not be our most urgent matter at present.
Until the next time an entity known as the Black Snake appears on this land.
—Internal Confidential Meeting Records of Rhodes Island Following the Saint Petersburg Incident
text.zh:
【权限记录】
乌萨斯发生了一场剧变，比我们预想的还要更快些。
我们目睹了一个帝国的终结，也见证了这片大地上第一个由感染者参与治理的常规国家的建立。
当然，这个消息的确振奋人心，这样的抗争称得上伟大。但是在欣喜之余，我们也要留意可能即将发生的变故。
乌萨斯的革命对于整个泰拉来说都会是一个强烈的信号，在其他国家，感染者的处境也许会迎来改变，可即便是好的改变也总是会伴随着阵痛。我们应当更多留意各地区对此事的反应，罗德岛有意愿在接下来可能发生的动荡里，尽我们所能阻止悲剧的发生。
值得庆幸的是，新的乌萨斯政府对与别国的沟通表现出积极的态度。卡西米尔、维多利亚也都愿意共同建立沟通机制。如果我们能以这种方式解决科罗萨主矿脉枯竭的危机，我们也有信心在任何困难里，证明如今的泰拉文明有存续下去的价值。
那么，现在的议题是，我们应当如何处理，与继承了“整合运动”这个名字的组织之间的关系。
……
我想我们可以达成共识了。
那些伤痛真实存在，不会因为时间而淡去，对任何一位经历过那些事件的干员来说都是如此。我们不会无条件地去谈论“宽恕”。
可是当我们再回顾五年前切尔诺伯格与龙门的事件，即便有着种种不堪与阴谋混杂其中，那些抗争也是如今革命的滥觞。
我们无法单纯地用“敌人”去描述整合运动，我们不会忘记那些战士与他们的信念。这条道路不算完美，在这其中，罗德岛致力于对抗的邪恶始终存在。
至于塔露拉——
罗德岛会保留继续监视她的权利，但这不会是我们当下最急切的事项。
直到下一次，名为黑蛇的存在出现在这片大地上。
——圣骏堡事变后，罗德岛内部机密会议记录

text.en:
[Report from the Saint Petersburg Office]
Inhibitors are never enough.
Transporting medicine all the way from the headquarters in Victoria to Ursus still takes far too long. The construction of a new factory must be put on the agenda; Saint Petersburg must possess the capacity to produce both medicine and protective equipment. Even if we must squeeze a bit more out of our already dangerously tight Originium reserves, we must also request Rhodes Island to dispatch more experts from the Engineering and Medical Departments here to guide the work. I truly dislike sounding so whiny, yet I must say... thank you.
...
Achieving "equality" for the Infected is far more difficult than we imagined.
Now, most people in the city hold a naive emotion, treating the Infected who survived the catastrophe together as compatriots, as if temporarily forgetting the differences between them. Yet I fear they will remember sooner or later. They will worry that a neighbor with whom they quarreled might suddenly unleash a massive fire with their bare hands to burn down their house, perhaps a coworker they were eating with just yesterday might suddenly explode into ashes right before your eyes—none of us can guarantee such things won't happen. Even if the new laws forbid people from speaking of these matters, how can one completely uproot such thoughts from people's minds? Driving a wedge into a wall with a hammer inevitably leaves cracks.
(The text continues...)
text.zh:
【来自圣骏堡办事处的报告】
抑制剂永远是不够用的。
药物从维多利亚的总部生产好再运到乌萨斯，时间还是太漫长。新工厂的建设必须提上日程，无论是药物还是防护设备，圣骏堡都必须要有生产能力。我们要从本就紧张到不能再紧张的源石储量里再抠一点出来，也得再请求罗德岛调派一些工程部和医疗部的专家来这里指导工作。我真不想这样矫情，但我还是得说……谢谢。
……
实现对感染者来说的“平等”远比我们想象的要困难。
现在，城中的大多数人怀着质朴的情感，将一同熬过了劫难的感染者当作同胞，仿佛暂时忘记了他们彼此之间的差异。可我担心，他们迟早会想起。他们会担忧发生了口角的邻居突然徒手放出一把大火烧掉自己的房子，也许是昨天还在一起吃饭的工友突然就在你面前炸成了灰——我们谁也不能保证这样的事情不会发生。就算新的法律禁止人们去谈论这些事，可要怎样才能把这样的念头从人们的脑子里摘除干净？用锤子硬生生把楔子敲进一堵墙里，不可能不留下裂痕的。
最大的挑战是，我们在为一个没有存在过的国家摸索前路，有些书中谈论过对她的猜想，可是谁也说不出她该是什么样子。没有人知道前面还有多少困难，这条路还有多长。
我知道，罗德岛还是想问塔露拉的下落。我的回答还是和原来一样——我真的不知道。
不只是你们，在这种时候人们都会本能地寻求指引，每个人都在问，那个带领队伍打进圣骏堡的战士去哪了？
现在圣骏堡里几乎每个人都知道，有一个勇敢的感染者击败了腐朽帝国的军队后销声匿迹。没有人愿意相信她死在了那个晚上。
我当然清楚塔露拉这样做的理由，整合运动有经不起审视的过往，而想要杜绝人们攻讦这面旗帜，最好的办法就是让它在适宜的时候从人们的视野中淡去。
不只是塔露拉，还有无数个，本该被记住，但是需要被隐藏起来的名字。
还是没有任何关于九的下落。我们花了很长时间去打扫城内的战场，只是见到了雷德的刀。现在想起来，其实我和他们相处的时间很短，可是当我看到那柄已经卷刃的长刀的时候，我应该也算认识了他。
也许等时局再稳定一点，人们还会建立一座博物馆，这柄刀应该放在其中显眼的位置，希望到那个时候，我能想明白该怎样写他们的悼词。
——柳德米拉

【写在《首都日报》第二版角落里的一则新闻】
感染者议员列夫·亚历山德罗维奇先生于昨日晚被发现在家中卧室上吊身亡，圣骏堡新警察厅对现场进行了严密的调查，初步排除他杀的可能。
需要特别指出的是，没有任何证据可以表明，亚历山德罗维奇先生的自杀与日前受到的杀人、抢劫等多项罪名的指控有关。提出控诉的人自称是中央区某村落的村民，此人现已接受警察厅的调查。
亚历山德罗维奇先生生前曾是一位资深的整合运动战士，在解放圣骏堡的战斗中做出了英勇的贡献。本报谨提醒广大市民，对任何试图挑拨感染者与普通人矛盾的谣言严加辨别。时刻牢记，感染者与普通人都是乌萨斯平等的公民，我们应当彼此相爱。

text.en:
[Greetings from Lungmen]
Long time no see.
Time flies, and the parting in Lungmen is already five years in the blink of an eye. Fai-kit has received much care from your esteemed company, for which I am deeply grateful.
In these turbulent times, the drastic change in Ursus has far-reaching impacts. Should Rhodes Island intend to negotiate with Yan regarding this matter, Lungmen will naturally offer an introduction to repay the great kindness of back then.
...
Allow me to temporarily set these topics aside in this private greeting. Disturbing you with this letter is solely for the sake of a single person.
This is truly a topic difficult to broach with outsiders; at the very least, it should not fall to me to speak of it. I had countless hesitations when writing this letter, yet without clarifying past events, this request cannot even be voiced.
I think the matter needs to begin rather earlier.
When I first met Yanguo in Lungmen, I did not yet know his background, simply taking him as a down-and-out martial artist with a sister, while Edward was merely a talented foreign wanderer. Yet when we recognized each other's identities, love had already taken root long beforehand. Although I was young at the time, I understood how ill-suited our identities were. Even so, love is thousands of times more real than status.
I will never be ashamed to speak of those youthful days—several young people brimming with vigor, believing they could fully unleash their ambitions, and believing they could protect those around them. Yanguo thought so, and how could I not? Yanguo regarded Edward as a sworn brother, and he was my brother too; Yanjing was Yanguo's sister, and naturally my sister as well.
How capricious fortune is, bringing together and making lovers of two pairs who ought never to have met. The difference was that Yanguo and I drew the absolute red line impassable to imperial authority, whereas Edward and Yan-jing did not. Thus, that unborn child became the source of all tragedy.
Of course, they were young and impulsive, and their actions rightly deserved all blame. Yet upon careful thought, is this not precisely the most absurd logic in this world? Love itself is without fault; hatred is what is wrong. It was only then that I understood: before those blind, colossal behemoths, discussing love, hate, right, and wrong is entirely meaningless.
Before his passing, Edward gave a name to his daughter and entrusted her to his wife's elder brother. With his brilliance, he must have long understood that such a helpless choice was destined to end in no good result, and the stories thereafter left only helplessness.
Little Tali grew up in such an environment where love was forbidden to be spoken of. I originally wanted to preserve a pure land for her growth, yet I still failed to prevent those rumors from reaching a child's ears. Like her father, she was precocious; she understood everything early on and must have hated it all to the core. I failed to protect her well, and this is my lifelong regret.
I ought not to have harbored expectations for Little Tali beyond growing up healthy, but when I heard of her deeds in Ursus, when I understood the ideals she fought for—despite all manner of twists and turns, despite the lingering guilt in my heart, I am still proud of her.
She grew up alone in a distant foreign land, and I can imagine the malice with which that Duke nurtured her, yet she did not become what anyone tried to mold her into. What she overthrew in Ursus and what caused her parents' tragedy were essentially one and the same.
Perhaps there are still idealists on this land who wish to accomplish the same things—to build a land that can hold all love.
I know Rhodes Island is searching for her, and perhaps only Rhodes Island can find her.
If you are able to find her, I also wish to ask you to protect her.
—Wai Fu
text.zh:
【来自龙门的问候】
久疏问候。
光阴飞逝，龙门一别转眼已是五年光景。晖洁受贵司关照良多，某深表感激。
时值动荡，乌萨斯剧变影响甚广，如若罗德岛有意就此事与大炎交涉，龙门自当引荐，以酬当年厚恩。
……
请允许我在这次私人的问候中暂且将这些话题按下不表，此番致信叨扰，也只为一人。
这实在是一个对外人难以启齿的话题，至少它本不该由我来说，我在动笔写下这封信时也有过万般犹豫，可是如果不将过去的事情说清，这一点请求也是无法开口的。
我想事情需要从更早的时候开始讲起。
与彦吾在龙门初识时，我尚且不知道他的身世，只当他是一个带着妹妹的落魄武者，而爱德华也不过是一个颇有才情的异邦游子。可是当我们认清彼此身份时，爱意早已先一步生根发芽。那时我虽然年轻，却也懂得彼此身份是多么不相宜。可即便如此，爱比身份要真实千万倍。
我永远不会愧于谈论那段年轻的时日，几个年轻人意气风发，相信自己可以尽情施展抱负，也相信自己可以保护身边的人。彦吾是如此想的，我又何尝不是。彦吾将爱德华视作异姓兄弟，他也是我的兄弟；炎景是彦吾的妹妹，自然也是我的妹妹。
造化何其弄人，它让两对本不该相遇的人相识相恋，区别在于，我和彦吾守住了于皇权而言最不可逾越的那道红线，爱德华和炎景则不然。于是，那个未出世的孩子成了一切悲剧的源头。
当然，他们年轻、冲动，他们的行为理应受到一切责备。可是细想来，这难道不正是这世上最荒唐的道理？爱本身是不会有错的，恨才有错。我也是直到那时才明白，在那些目不能视的庞然巨物面前，谈论爱恨对错都是毫无意义的。
爱德华在临终前为女儿取了名字，将她托付给自己妻子的胞兄，聪慧如他想必早就明白了，这样无可奈何的选择注定不会有好的结果，而此后的故事，便也只剩下了无可奈何。
小塔是在这样不被允许谈论爱的环境中长大的，我本想为她的成长保留一处净土，可是我依然没能阻止那些流言传入一个孩子的耳朵。她就像她的父亲一样早慧，她早早明白了一切，想必也恨透了这一切。我没能做到保护好她，这是我的毕生憾事。
我本不该为小塔寄予健康成长之外的期望，可是当我听说了她在乌萨斯的事迹，当我了解了她为之奋斗的理想——纵然有种种意外波折，纵然我心中仍有愧疚，我还是为她感到骄傲。
她在遥远的异邦独自成长，我能想象那位公爵用怎样的恶意浇灌她，但她没有变成任何人试图塑造的样子。她在乌萨斯推翻的事物，与造成她的父母悲剧的事物，本就是一种东西。
也许这片大地上仍有理想的人，想做的事也都是一样的——去建设一片容得下所有爱的地方。
我知道罗德岛在找她，也许只有罗德岛能够找到她。
如果你们能找到她的话，我也想请求你们保护她。
——文月

text.en:
[Letter from Ch'en Hui-chieh]
I found her.
No surprises, this is merely a simple notification. She is currently well, as are we both. Please rest assured. Before I bring her back to Rhodes Island, I need to provide some explanation of the current situation.
I witnessed with my own eyes what happened that night in Saint Petersburg; such a drastic change is difficult for many to comprehend, and I have no way of figuring out exactly what transpired within it. News of the capture of the Amber Palace spread to the villages surrounding Saint Petersburg only the next day, and turmoil followed closely behind. I saw many people rejoicing, others weeping bitterly, and naturally no shortage of those looking to profit from the chaos. For the past few months, the administrative system throughout the Central District had long since collapsed, and now it remains on the verge of erupting into the next crisis at any moment.
Just a few hours after the turmoil broke out, a squad composed of the Infected arrived at the village. At first, the people here were surprised that their uniforms bore no griffin emblem. Immediately following that, I saw with my own eyes how they began to maintain order; they took out scarce food and medicine to distribute to the uneasy villagers and explained to the villagers why Ursus would no longer have an emperor from this day forward. Regardless, in times like these, a neatly disciplined military force was enough to quiet the people—yes, this army called itself "Reunion." Naturally, this name became the only name people could trust in the present moment.
These sights naturally shocked me; I will not easily trust anyone's verbal promises, but neither can I deny the facts seen with my own eyes—this truly is the current face of Reunion.
In the farmstead on the Ursus border, she did indeed discuss her expectations for Reunion with me. She said the only way to make people let go of hatred is to make them believe, to make them believe that in their future lives, there are things more wonderful than revenge waiting for them.
I am not certain how the political situation in Ursus will develop; perhaps what I witnessed in this village will repeat itself elsewhere in Ursus. At this very moment, I choose to believe, to believe that what the name "Reunion" represents is already different from the past.
After that, in a place with special significance for Reunion, I "crossed paths" with her.
Time is too tight; we will seek help from a nearby office first. However, I cannot yet—at least not right now—inform Rhodes Island of her whereabouts. I am sorry, I know this is a willful decision. Under such political circumstances, countless people must still be searching for her. Merely the title of "Reunion's Leader" is enough to throw a place into turmoil. Therefore, I will not bring her back to Central Office right now; from all perspectives, this should be the correct choice. I promise that when the appropriate time comes, I will surely bring her back, and at that time, we can slowly clarify past events.
I will not forget my promise to keep an eye on her, and I will never forget to grant her a fair trial. Yet when I saw her covered in blood, I could not avoid recalling that she is still my sister.
I must protect her.
I believe that a place fair enough to judge Talulah is no longer out of reach.
Please trust me.
text.zh:
【来自陈晖洁的信件】
我找到她了。
没有什么意外，这只是作为一个简单的通知。目前她还安好，我们都是。请放心。在我带她回罗德岛之前，我需要对当下的情况进行一些说明。
我亲眼目睹了那一晚发生在圣骏堡的事，这样的剧变对许多人来说都难以理解，我也没办法弄清楚其中究竟发生了什么。琥珀宫被攻占的消息隔天才传到圣骏堡周遭的村庄，动乱也紧随而来。我见到不少人欢欣鼓舞，也有人失声痛哭，当然也少不了想要趁乱谋利的人。近几个月来整个中央区的行政系统早已瘫痪，现在更是时刻处在爆发下一场危机的边缘。
就在动乱发生的几个小时后，一支感染者组成的队伍到达了村庄。起初这里的人都惊讶于他们的制服上没有骏鹰的标志。紧接着，我亲眼看到他们开始主持秩序，他们拿出了不算多的食物和药物分发给不安的村民，并且向村民解释为何乌萨斯从此以往不会再有皇帝。无论如何，在这样的时候一支军容整齐的队伍就足以让人们安静下来——是的，这一支军队自称为“整合运动”。这个名字也就理所当然地成为了人们在当下唯一能信任的名字。
这些景象当然令我震惊，我不会轻易相信任何人语言上的许诺，但也无法否认亲眼见到的事实——这的确是整合运动当下的面貌。
在乌卡边境的农庄里，她的确与我谈论过对整合运动的期许。她说过，唯一能让人们放下仇恨的办法是让人们相信，相信在未来的人生里，有比复仇更美好的事物在等着他们。
我不确定乌萨斯的时局会如何发展，也许在这座村庄里的见闻还会在乌萨斯其他地方重复上演。在此时此刻，我选择相信，相信“整合运动”这个名字所代表的事物已然与往日不同。
在那之后，在一个对整合运动有着特殊意义的地方，我“碰见”了她。
时间太紧张了，我们会先在附近办事处寻求帮助。可是我还不能——至少现在还不能告知罗德岛她的下落。抱歉，我知道这是自作主张的决定。在这样的时局下，一定还有无数人在找她。仅仅是“整合运动的领袖”这个名号，就足以搅得一个地方不得安宁。所以我不会现在就带她回本部，从各方角度来讲这都应该是一个正确的选择。我保证，等到一个合适的时候，我一定会带她回去，到那时，我们可以再慢慢将过去的事情说清。
我不会忘记要一直盯着她的承诺，也绝不会忘记要给予她一场公正的审判。可是当我看到她浑身是血的样子时，也会无法避免地想起，她还是我的姐姐。
我必须得保护她。
我相信，那个公正到可以审判塔露拉的地方，不再遥不可及了。
请相信我。

text.en:
We meet at last.
It was Hui-chieh who told you that you could find me here, wasn't it? I know she never intended to hide it from the very beginning.
No, I was not trying to hide from anyone, nor did I ever intend to evade my past; I simply wished to finish a personal task before facing those who wish to judge me.
Such as this memorial.
Please forgive me, I presumptuously left behind some names that do not belong to Reunion; I merely believe that those who left their names here share the same reason for which they fought.
And this reason still exists to this day.
Therefore, if Rhodes Island has need of me, let me walk with you. You can trust my fire, and my sword.
I will no longer speak of what price I ought to pay for redemption—I no longer pray for forgiveness, but for meaning. I ought to ignite my finite life to illuminate as many corners of this land as possible that remain buried in shadow.
Someone also needs to stay alive to bear witness, to tell those lingering on this gravestone that this land has become better than when they left, and their sacrifices were not in vain.
We have forged a new domain. In this new land, there are those continuing to pass on their ideals, and those willing to remember their names.
Until I, too, become one of the countless names upon this gravestone.
...You agree?
Then, we are companions.
Is it cold here? Indeed, winter does not pass so easily; a truly bright spring is still far off.
Let us shake hands.
text.zh:
我们终于见面了。
是晖洁告诉你，可以在这里找到我对吗？我知道，她从一开始就没打算瞒着你。
不，我并不是想要躲着谁，也从来没有打算回避我的过去，我只是想在直面想要审判我的人之前，做完一点自己的事。
比如这一场悼念。
请见谅，我擅自在上面留下了一些不属于整合运动的名字，我只是认为，那些把名字留在这里的人，他们为之战斗的理由是一样的。
而这个理由至今依然存在。
所以，如果罗德岛有需要的话，就让我和你们一起走吧。你可以相信我的火，还有我的剑。
我不会再说自己应该用什么样的代价去赎罪——我祈求的不再是宽恕，而是意义。我应该把有限的生命点燃，去尽可能照亮这片大地至今依然被埋藏在阴影里的角落。
也需要有人活着见证，告诉停留在这座墓碑上的人，这片大地比起他们离开时变得更好，他们的牺牲没有白费。
我们创造了一片新的国度。在这片新的土地上，有人在继续传颂他们的理想，有人愿意记住他们的名字。
直到我也成为这座墓碑上无数名字中的一个。
……你同意了？
那么，我们就算是同伴了。
这里很冷吗？是啊，冬天没那么容易过去，真正明媚的春天还远呢。
来握个手吧。
